newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens sharply lower, hit by Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens sharply lower, hit by Dow.

text.p: Britain's leading share index opened nearly 1.5 percent lower on Monday as investors locked in profits after its record run was halted on Friday with the biggest point loss since 1987.
The FTSE 100 was trading down 72.3 points or 1.49 percent at 4,793.5 by 0842 GMT, its weakest price since July 11. The broader FTSE 250 fell 49.9 points or 1.06 percent to 4,648.3.
